title: Three things we
noticed about OIRT
Three things
we noticed
about OIRT
sections.kicker: Prepared for OIRT by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: OIRT sells its system before it shows the work that makes anyone want the system.
sections.keep: The numbers under the headline. Forty two works for twelve brands is a real record, stated plainly.

pins.what: The headline promises one platform and one system.
pins.why: It describes how OIRT is organized, not what a brand looks like after working with it.
pins.how: Open on a result a client would recognize and let the platform follow as proof.
pins.label: Your headline
pins.cost: An agency chosen for its workflow competes with software, not with other agencies.

pins.what: The proof sits in small numbers and the work itself is a secondary button.
pins.why: The twelve brands are the strongest evidence that OIRT can build a brand, and none is named or shown.
pins.how: Show two of those twelve brands above the diagram.
pins.label: Your numbers
pins.cost: The visitor leaves without seeing a single thing OIRT has made.

pins.area: A dark flow diagram of numbered boxes joined by dotted lines with pink and teal tags
pins.what: The diagram of boxes and channels fills the first screen in dark, pink and teal.
pins.why: It reads as a software product, and it does not show what OIRT has made for brands.
pins.how: Keep the platform and give the brand identity the same weight on screen.
pins.label: Your diagram
pins.cost: A first look at the brand suggests a tool, not a studio with taste.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on OIRT's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Pentagram, from another category. It shows the work first, and the process earns trust afterwards.
